products.name: Artisan Caramel Latte
products.description: Rich double espresso, steamed silky whole milk, topped with handcrafted golden caramel drizzle.

products.name: Classic Cappuccino
products.description: Bold dark roast espresso with dense velvety microfoam, lightly dusted with Valrhona cocoa.

products.name: Ceremonial Matcha Latte
products.description: Single-estate ceremonial Uji matcha whisked with silky steamed milk and subtle vanilla sweetness.

products.name: Single Origin Cold Brew
products.description: 18-hour slow-steeped Ethiopian specialty beans, poured over clear ice for a smooth, chocolatey finish.

products.name: Almond Croissant
products.description: Freshly baked flaky buttery croissant filled with rich almond frangipane and toasted flakes.

products.name: Wild Berry Cheesecake
products.description: Creamy New York cheesecake on a buttery biscuit base, crowned with seasonal wild berry compote.

products.name: Dark Chocolate Chunk Cookie
products.description: Soft-centred cookie packed with Belgian dark chocolate chunks and finished with Maldon sea salt flakes.

products.name: Slow-Cooked Beef Bhuna
products.description: Tender beef chuck simmered slowly with mustard oil, roasted cumin, and caramelized shallots.

products.name: Kacchi Mutton Biryani
products.description: Fragrant Chinigura rice and marinated tender mutton slow-steeped in a dough-sealed pot with saffron and potatoes.

products.name: Charcoal Chicken Skewers
products.description: Boneless chicken marinated in hung curd, ginger, and Bengali panch phoron, charred over charcoal.

products.name: Peyaju (Crisp Lentil Fritters)
products.description: Crunchy red lentil fritters spiced with green chillies, coriander, and served with tangy tamarind dip.

products.name: Seasonal Vegetable Korma
products.description: Garden vegetables gently poached in a creamy cashew and coconut milk sauce with aromatic cardamom.

products.name: Garlic Butter Tandoori Naan
products.description: Leavened tandoor flatbread brushed with crushed roasted garlic and pure clarified butter (ghee).

products.name: Fresh Mint Lime Soda
products.description: Freshly squeezed Kagoji lime, garden mint, cane sugar, and sparkling soda water over crushed ice.

products.name: Gazipur TOK DOI
products.description: Traditional artisanal sour curd (tok doi) from Gazipur, naturally fermented in earthen pots for a rich and wholesome tang.
